name: ManageEngine Endpoint Central
summary: Endpoint Central bundles patching with device management for Windows, Mac, Linux and third-party applications. Professional starts at $1.32 per endpoint per month, or $795 a year for 50 endpoints. A free edition covers up to 25 endpoints, and the 30-day trial runs the full feature set.

facts.text: The patch page claims testing and deployment of patches for over 1000 third-party applications.
Deployment policies set days, weeks, install windows and reboot behavior, and offline computers can be woken on LAN.
Missing Patches and System Health reports export as PDF or CSV.
Driver and BIOS patching appears from the Enterprise edition, and vulnerability remediation from the Security edition.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: From $1.32 per endpoint per month. Automated patching including third-party apps

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: From $1.57 per endpoint per month. Adds driver and BIOS patching

plans.name: Security
plans.notes: From $2.82 per endpoint per month. Adds vulnerability remediation

hiddenCosts: The cards show starting prices for the smallest tier, and the page does not label them as cloud or on-premises.
Driver and BIOS patching needs Enterprise or higher.
